utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Mara, have you heard anything about that repair drive on Saturday? I'm trying to figure out what it's all about.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh yes, it's a whole neighborhood effort! We're fixing up fences, porches, and even small appliances. I'll be at the community center by 7:45 to help coordinate—you should come by!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds great! I'll try to make it there—do you need me to bring anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Vik! Have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're gathering at the community center from 10 to 4—bring any broken items you'd like to fix!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I've been telling everyone about it! I'm planning to bring my old toaster, and I've already got a few neighbors lined up to pitch in their tools.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's awesome, Vik! Having extra tools and people spreading the word will really make this drive a success.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I'm late—did I miss anything important about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Dane, no worries! Jules is coordinating the schedule, and I'll be bringing my toolbox and some spare shelves for storage. Ready when you are.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, Gus. Just tell me who needs help first, and I'll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: 9 AM, not 10. We're fixing chairs and a lamp this time. Bring your tools.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, right, 9 AM! And tools... I think I have a hammer somewhere. I'll look for it when I get home—if I remember!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Check your screwdriver too. We'll need one.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're actually going to use that old drive to fix my router? Are you sure it's safe?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'm just bringing basic tools for a power issue—nothing risky. Did Leo say anything about your router specifically?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Leo? He's a handyman, not an electronics expert. I'd rather not have my router turned into a fire hazard.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Cleo, just to confirm, the repair drive is at the old garage on Elm Street—we're meeting there at 9 AM sharp!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That's right, Faye—Elm Street garage at 9! I've got a good pile of tools and parts ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Wonderful, thanks Cleo! I'll add you to the volunteer list so everything runs smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Opal secured the space? So it's at the old garage on Elm Street, not the community center?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I think so, but I'm not entirely sure. I heard it was the garage, but I'm waiting for confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So you're not even sure where this thing is happening? How are people supposed to bring their stuff if nobody's got the location straight?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: A repair drive on Sunday, got it. I'll start organizing a schedule so we don't have too many people overlapping in the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh great, thanks Pia! That'll keep things from getting too messy.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'll also check how many electrical outlets are available so we don't blow a fuse with all those tools.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey! Glad to see you're thinking about the repair drive, Oren. That old toaster sounds like a perfect project—want me to take a look at it this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard about that at the store. What time does it start on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It kicks off at 10 a.m. sharp at the community center. I'll be there fixing things up—hope to see you there!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Eli, I can help sort donations if you need a hand. Just let me know how you want things organized.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well now, Rey, that's mighty kind of you. I do have a system—electronics in one pile, small appliances in another. We can start with whatever you're comfortable handling.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Small appliances sound perfect. I'll start sorting those right away.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, a repair drive? I thought we were just fixing one fence — did I miss something?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh no, it's a whole community thing at the center this Saturday. Vik's setting it up, and folks are bringing broken stuff to fix together.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, at the community center? I thought it was just a fence—how did I miss all this?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Rosa, I heard you're helping organize the repair drive—that's perfect, you always keep everything running so smoothly!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess! I'm glad you're on board—just a heads-up, we've moved it to Sunday at the community center. Can I count on you to help out?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course you can count on me, Rosa! I'll bring my gardening gloves in case we need to tidy up the flower beds around the center too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Vik, glad you're here! Have you got any spare tools we could use for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, absolutely! I'm planning to set up the repair drive for this Saturday, so if you have any spare tools, that'd be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks Vik! I've got my garage on Elm Street all stocked, so bring whatever you can spare.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, so it's not just the fence? There's a whole repair drive now?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I think Eli is organizing it at the community center this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh man, I totally missed that memo. I've been so focused on that broken fence, I didn't realize it turned into a whole neighborhood thing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, you know, just the usual—lawnmowers and Leo's old fridge, I think.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it. I'll bring extra wrenches for the fridge.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, Leo. I think that's all we've got on the list, anyway.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Eli! You're coming to the repair drive too, right? I'll be there fixing things up.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I'll be there. I've got the schedule all mapped out—would you like a copy to coordinate your time slot?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, that'd be great! I'd love to see when folks are bringing their items so I can plan my tool setup.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, the repair drive? I heard something about that while I was at the grocery store. What's the latest?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: It's actually a power issue at the old mill, not just a fence repair. I'm bringing my wrench and screwdrivers, but no diagnostic gear—Leo's instructions were pretty specific.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Ah, power issue—that's more serious than a fence. I've got my toaster and blender ready for Saturday; glad Leo gave clear instructions.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi everyone, thanks for coming to talk about the repair drive this Saturday. We need to coordinate pickup times and locations.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Saturday? So it's definitely happening then—are we still using the old garage on Elm Street or has that changed?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, it's still the old garage on Elm Street — I confirmed it with the owner just yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey everyone, sorry I'm late! What's this repair drive all about?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It's this Saturday at the old garage on Elm Street. We're fixing up donated items for the community.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, that sounds awesome! I'll definitely try to make it. Do you need me to bring any tools?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Just heard we're gonna need some extra hands—I'll grab my toolbox and meet you guys on Oak Street Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hang on, Gus—Saturday morning on Oak Street? The repair drive is at the community center, isn't it? Are we sure everyone's on the same page about the location?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh, I thought it was on Oak Street—Tess mentioned that pothole. But if it's at the community center, I'll head there instead. Thanks for the heads-up, Kira.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Jules! You're going to make it to the repair drive this Saturday, right? We'll be at the community center from 10 to 4!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I'll be there! I even got a few folks from the gardening club to bring some tools and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's amazing, Jules! With the gardening club on board, we'll have everything we need to really make a difference.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, Faye, I'm still committed for Saturday! I'll be at the community center by 7:45 to help coordinate—just let me know what time works for the kids.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, Mara! I heard Gus is bringing his whole toolbox, so we'll be all set.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Gus's tools will come in handy. I'll make sure the sign-in sheets are ready and we can direct folks to the right stations.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Rosa! The repair drive... I was just trying to remember if I was supposed to bring my old toaster or if that was for something else. I'll be there though!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh perfect, Oren! Bring that toaster—we're at the community center on Sunday now, not Saturday on the front porch. We'll get it fixed up!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sunday, right, at the community center—got it! I'll bring the toaster, though I might forget where I put it by then. Thanks, Rosa!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, I heard we're having a repair drive soon. I'm planning to help with small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll be there too, helping with electrical repairs.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, sounds like we'll have a good team. Do you know if we're setting up in the community hall again?
